hypotheses.justification: `hA` is implied by `hpi`. `Expr.arrow l A B` is defined as `.pi l A (B.rename Nat.succ)` (Wrappers.lean line 65). The lemma `HasType.generation_pi` (Labelled.lean line 801) applies to `hpi`, after unfolding `arrow` with `show`/`change`. It gives `∃ s₁ s₂ s₃, HasType P Γ A (.sort s₁) ∧ …`. Take `s₁` from that and use the resulting `HasType P Γ A (.sort s₁)` wherever `hA` was used. Both uses are in the call `product hA mA hpi hl (hB.rename (Embedding.cons hA l.domain))`. The variable `s` appears only in `hA`, so it simply drops out of the statement. Nothing else in the statement mentions `hA`: `mA`, `hpi`, `hl`, `hB` and the conclusion do not. The theorem is therefore still true and provable without `hA`. Only `hA` is claimed removable; `hpi` is still needed.
